verdict.rationale: Rootly is an on-call scheduling product, so a calendar-feed sync story applies to it. The evidence documents schedules with rotations, layers, overrides, restrictions and previews, plus mobile shift swaps. Nothing in the pack mentions an iCal/webcal feed or syncing shifts to a personal calendar. Schedule previews and the mobile app are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an on-call engineer, my shifts sync to my personal calendar via a feed so I always know when I'm on the hook
